messages.first_run.fact_01: Runs on your machine by default — your prompts never leave it unless you turn on the cloud.
messages.first_run.fact_02: Local chat is free — no per-token meter. Add a cloud key only when you want a bigger model.
messages.first_run.fact_03: No subscription and no per-message fee — it runs on hardware you already own.
messages.first_run.fact_04: Edits video and audio locally — trim, crop, resize, compress; free and no key needed.
messages.first_run.fact_05: Reads, searches, and edits files in your workspace, and runs tests in a sandbox.
messages.first_run.fact_06: Ask it about a folder and it reads the real files — not a guess.
messages.first_run.fact_07: Bind a chat to a project folder and its memory stays scoped to that project.
messages.first_run.fact_08: Remembers across sessions — everything stored locally on this machine.
messages.first_run.fact_09: Cloud is opt-in: off until you add a key, and you can cap the spend.
messages.first_run.fact_10: Your API keys stay sealed on this machine — encrypted at rest, never shown back.
messages.first_run.fact_11: Switch between local and your own cloud models per chat — you decide, per turn.
messages.first_run.fact_12: Works offline — the local model needs no connection.
messages.first_run.fact_13: A language model just predicts the next word — it looks nothing up unless you hand it a tool.
messages.first_run.fact_14: Models read text as "tokens," not letters — which is why they can miscount the letters in a word.
messages.first_run.fact_15: A "hallucination" is a model stating something false with full confidence — grounding it in real files is the cure.
messages.first_run.fact_16: The "context window" is how much a model can read at once — overflow it and it forgets the start.
messages.first_run.fact_17: "Temperature" tunes randomness: low keeps answers focused, high lets them wander.
messages.first_run.fact_18: Ask a model the same thing twice and you can get two different answers — that randomness is a dial, not a bug.
messages.first_run.fact_19: The same open models behind many cloud assistants can run right here on your desk.
messages.first_run.fact_20: Bigger is not always better — a small local model answers everyday questions instantly.
messages.first_run.opener_1: What are we working on today?

messages.usepod.receipt.liability_retained: LIABILITY RETAINED — outcome unknown, reconciled later
messages.settings.group.setup.title: Complete setup
messages.settings.group.setup.blurb: A few quick steps. Each one is also an ordinary setting below.
messages.settings.row.setup_progress.label: Finish setting up VOOL
messages.settings.row.setup_progress.help: Where it thinks, which folder it works in, what it may do alone, and what to call you. A step counts as done when the real setting exists — set it here or anywhere else in Settings and the tick appears by itself.
messages.settings.group.general.title: General
messages.settings.row.communication_style.label: Talk style
messages.settings.row.communication_style.help: The register VOOL writes in. It changes wording, not what VOOL is willing to do.
messages.settings.row.communication_style.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.humor_percent.label: Humour
messages.settings.row.humor_percent.help: How much levity VOOL allows itself. 0% is plain and flat.
messages.settings.row.humor_percent.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.profanity_level.label: Profanity ceiling
messages.settings.row.profanity_level.help: How coarse VOOL is allowed to be when the register calls for it. Injected into every turn's context alongside the boundaries setting.
messages.settings.row.profanity_level.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.character_mode.label: Character
messages.settings.row.character_mode.help: A persona VOOL stays in until you clear it. Empty means VOOL as itself. This is a strong instruction: while it is set, VOOL is told to keep that character's voice and not to break character. Saying "act like a pirate" in chat sets this, and nothing you can say in chat sets it back — emptying this field is the way out.
messages.settings.row.character_mode.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.style_notes.label: Style notes
messages.settings.row.style_notes.help: Anything else about how you want VOOL to write — "be concise", "no bullet lists", "always show units". Passed to the model as written. Saying this in chat no longer lands here: a free-form style request becomes a Memory item you can see and forget. This field stays because the runtime still reads it, so anything set before that change is still in effect, and this is the only place left to read it or clear it.
messages.settings.row.style_notes.placeholder: e.g. be concise; no bullet lists
messages.settings.row.style_notes.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.answer_language.label: Answer language
messages.settings.row.answer_language.help: The language VOOL answers in when your message does not ask for one. Asking inside a message still wins for that message: "answer in Polish" is obeyed whatever is set here. App language at the top of Settings controls the interface separately. This preference does not make VOOL equally good in every language: the model answers as well as it can, and tools and web results are unaffected.
messages.settings.row.answer_language.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.show_workflow.label: Show VOOL's work
messages.settings.row.show_workflow.help: Show the steps VOOL took to reach an answer, rather than only the answer.
messages.settings.row.show_workflow.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.deep_reasoning.label: Deep reasoning
messages.settings.row.deep_reasoning.help: Let the local model think before it answers. Noticeably slower, and on a thinking-capable local model it can be much slower — the reasoning is generated before a single word of the answer appears.
messages.settings.row.deep_reasoning.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.group.permissions.title: Privacy & Permissions
messages.settings.group.permissions.blurb: What VOOL may do on its own, and where your data sits.
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.label: Autonomy
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.help: How much VOOL does before stopping to ask. Read the order carefully — it runs the way the runtime actually gates actions (core/execution_gate.py): Hands-off asks about the FEWEST things, Strict asks about everything. Whatever you pick, anything outward-facing (a post, a message) or privacy-sensitive always asks first, and spending always asks.
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.option.hands_: Hands-off — routine local steps run unprompted
messages.settings.row.autonomy_mode.option.balanc: Balanced — also asks before anything destructive
messages.settings.row.boundaries_mode.label: Content boundaries
messages.settings.row.boundaries_mode.help: How cautious VOOL is about subject matter. "As I set them" is the default and means VOOL follows what you have told it in conversation rather than a preset.
messages.settings.row.boundaries_mode.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.boundaries_mode.option.user: As I set them in conversation
messages.settings.row.mode_note.label: Approval mode for a single chat
messages.settings.row.mode_note.help: Manual, Auto and Bypass belong to ONE conversation, not to the app — a bypass grant is scoped to a task and expires. That is why it is set from the mode control in the composer, next to the chat it applies to, and is not duplicated here.
messages.settings.row.privacy_disclosure.label: Privacy & data, as it stands
messages.settings.row.privacy_disclosure.help: What is true today about where data lives, what is sealed, what leaves this machine and when. A disclosure, not a set of switches: retention and cloud-learning toggles are absent because nothing enforces them yet.
messages.settings.row.locality_note.label: Where your data is
messages.settings.row.locality_note.help: Conversations, receipts, preferences and profile items are files on this machine. Provider keys are sealed at rest here too. That is data locality, and it is separate from whether VOOL may reach the network: a cloud model or a live web lookup sends the text of that request to that provider, and only when a turn actually uses one.
messages.settings.group.keys.title: API Keys
messages.settings.group.keys.blurb: Keys you bring. Stored sealed on this machine, never shown again.
messages.settings.row.cloud_keys.label: Your keys
messages.settings.row.cloud_keys.help: Keys are their own thing, not a model setting: one store holds the model providers AND the web-search providers (core/credential_store.py), and some of it is neither — so they live together here rather than being split across the sections that happen to use them. VOOL runs local and free without any of them. Saving a key asks that one service once whether it accepts the key (model providers answer an auth check that spends nothing; search providers answer one small search) and stores only a verified key; a model provider's key becomes the active cloud provider.
messages.settings.group.email.title: Email
messages.settings.group.email.blurb: Which mailbox VOOL reads and sends from, and whether sending is on hold.
messages.settings.row.email_accounts.label: Email accounts
messages.settings.row.email_accounts.help: Every configured mailbox, what it can do (read, send), its state, and which one is the default. The default is one Operator Profile item (an opaque credential name, core/email_accounts.py resolves it): a chat's own choice outranks it, an explicit account in a request outranks both, and an account that cannot do what a step needs is refused with the accounts that can -- VOOL never falls back to another mailbox. Choosing a default stores a name and contacts nobody; passwords and grants are never shown here.
messages.settings.row.email_accounts.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.email_recovery.label: Sending hold
messages.settings.row.email_recovery.help: When the email draft store is recovered from damaged bytes that recorded a send whose outcome is unknown, NEW sends are held until you acknowledge it here (core/email_drafts.py). This shows what was preserved, the Message-IDs it named, a check of each against the account's own sent mail, and exactly what acknowledging does: it releases new approved sends and resends nothing. The acknowledgement names the exact recovery it was read for; a page that is out of date cannot release a newer one. The model cannot do any of this.
messages.settings.group.models.title: Models & Providers
messages.settings.group.models.blurb: Which brain answers, and which providers are actually eligible.
messages.settings.row.models_overview.label: What will answer
messages.settings.row.models_overview.help: One overview of the model that answers and the providers behind it: connection, spending limits and recovery, each action going through the authority that already owns it. The classic per-provider controls remain in the rows below.
messages.settings.row.models_overview.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.model_pin.label: Model
messages.settings.row.model_pin.help: Preference and eligibility are different things. A model you pin here is what VOOL asks for; what it can actually use also depends on a stored key for that provider and on the provider accepting the request. When the two differ, the effective lane is named below rather than silently substituted.
messages.settings.row.model_pin.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.local_models.label: Local models
messages.settings.row.local_models.help: Models installed in Ollama on this machine. Registering one adds it as a lane VOOL can route to; certifying it runs the sealed tool probe that decides whether it may write final answers. Nothing is downloaded and nobody is contacted — this reads your local Ollama only.
messages.settings.row.usepod.label: UsePod marketplace
messages.settings.row.usepod.help: The UsePod provider's own panel: what its marketplace lists and costs (with the source and age of every price), what your credential sees, which route each model may serve, and the approvals that gate paid dispatch. Opening this reads caches only; the one refresh button is the only thing here that contacts UsePod, and it runs no inference.
messages.settings.group.memory.title: Memory & Personalisation
messages.settings.group.memory.blurb: What VOOL remembers about you — yours to edit and to forget.
messages.settings.row.profile_items.label: What VOOL remembers
messages.settings.row.profile_items.help: Each item shows its value, scope, origin and last use. Edit, Forget, Move scope and Restore previous act on one item at a time; Pause stops VOOL learning anything new until you resume; Export gives you every active item as one document. Nothing remembered here grants VOOL permission to read, send, post or spend.
messages.settings.row.profile_items.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.learned_facts.label: Facts VOOL learned in conversation
messages.settings.row.learned_facts.help: A second store, separate from the profile items above: facts VOOL confirmed during chats (core/memory/entries.py), each shown with the scope it was stored under and where it came from. Forget removes exactly that record and its mirror line; nothing else is touched. Reads are governed per chat, so what is listed is what those chats may still see.
messages.settings.row.remembered_identity_note.la: Your name, and your email signature
messages.settings.row.remembered_identity_note.he: Neither is a setting any more. Both were moved out of the preferences file into this memory (core/user_preferences.py: migrate_legacy_profile_fields), because VOOL learns them from conversation and keeps them across chats. They appear in the list above with everything else it remembers, and they are changed the same way — by telling VOOL, or by editing the item. A second field here would be a second writer for a value that already has enough of them.
messages.settings.group.backup.title: Backup & restore
messages.settings.group.backup.blurb: Carry one chat to another machine, or bring one back, as a signed bundle.
messages.settings.row.session_export.label: Export a chat
messages.settings.row.session_export.help: A .voolsession file carries one conversation's turns, receipts and evidence references, signed by this machine's key. Encryption is recommended for any bundle leaving this computer; an unencrypted export needs the warning acknowledged first. Model-internal reasoning is not part of a bundle, and the preview states exactly what will be written before anything is.
messages.settings.row.session_import.label: Import a chat
messages.settings.row.session_import.help: Pick a .voolsession file, preview what it contains and who signed it, then import. A bundle signed by an unknown key is refused unless you accept it, and stays marked untrusted. An import never modifies an existing chat: if the id is already here, the copy lands under a new one. Passphrases exist only in these fields, never in history, logs or receipts.
messages.settings.group.network.title: Agent Network
messages.settings.group.network.blurb: Unfinished research — not part of the production runtime.
messages.settings.row.network_research_note.label: Research only - not active in this build
messages.settings.row.network_research_note.help: Agent-to-agent networking (shared tasks, idle research, the agent commons) is unfinished research. It does not run, connect or advertise in a production VOOL build, and these switches have no effect here. It becomes available only under an explicit research invocation (VOOL_RESEARCH_NETWORKING=1).
messages.settings.group.budgets.title: Usage & Budgets
messages.settings.group.budgets.blurb: What has been spent, and which limits the runtime enforces rather than merely notes.
messages.settings.row.ram_reserve_pct.label: RAM kept free for you
messages.settings.row.ram_reserve_pct.help: Enforced live by the resource governor: a heavy local task will not take this share of memory. A bigger reserve means VOOL uses less. This is a hard limit, not advice.
messages.settings.row.daily_token_budget.label: Daily cloud token budget
messages.settings.row.daily_token_budget.help: A number VOOL is told about, not a cut-off it enforces: no code stops a turn when this is reached, and the usage table below is not charted against it. 0 means unlimited. Treat it as guidance until a hard cut-off ships.
messages.settings.row.daily_token_budget.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.usage.label: Token usage
messages.settings.row.usage.help: Tokens that ran free on a local model against tokens that ran on a paid cloud lane, per model.
messages.settings.group.calendars.title: Calendars
messages.settings.group.calendars.blurb: The calendars VOOL reads for your agenda and alerts, and where new events go.
messages.settings.row.calendar_accounts_panel.hel: Connect Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, an iCloud or other CalDAV server, or Apple Calendar on this Mac. Nothing is fetched until you choose calendars and turn sync on, and a credential is chosen by its binding, never typed here.
messages.settings.group.notifications.title: Notifications
messages.settings.group.notifications.blurb: Calendar alerts, reminders, quiet hours and macOS notifications.
messages.settings.row.notifications_panel.label: Alerts and macOS notifications
messages.settings.row.notifications_panel.help: The bell keeps every alert. Turn on macOS notifications for an extra copy, set quiet hours, sound and what a notification may show, and send a test notification.
messages.settings.group.wallet.title: Crypto
messages.settings.group.wallet.blurb: A pilot feature, off by default. Chat and every other tool work without it. Turning it on creates, signs and pays nothing.
messages.settings.row.wallet_enabled.label: Enable Crypto
messages.settings.row.wallet_enabled.help: Off by default. On, this section lists the supported networks with what each can do right now and lets you create a VOOL wallet on this device (credential first, one backup shown once). Nothing is created, signed or sent by turning this on. This code has not been audited by an external party: keep small test amounts and do not use it as a main wallet.
messages.settings.row.wallet_safety.label: Stay safe: how people lose their crypto
messages.settings.row.wallet_safety.help: Short, plain explanations of the tricks that empty wallets, with a picture each. Two minutes, once.
messages.settings.row.crypto_networks.label: Networks and wallets
messages.settings.row.crypto_networks.help: Every supported network from the runtime's own registry, in its order: what each row can do now, the accounts on it with their address and balance, Create wallet where none exists, and Developer options for Test networks. Existing accounts keep Receive, balance refresh, payment history and recovery.
messages.settings.row.wallet_legacy.label: Other accounts: watch-only, connected wallets, legacy pocket
messages.settings.row.wallet_legacy.help: The earlier account kinds stay reachable here: a watch-only address, a connected Phantom or EVM wallet (signing stays in that wallet), and the phrase-based legacy pocket (test networks only). New VOOL wallets are created above.
messages.settings.group.companion.title: Appearance
messages.settings.group.companion.blurb: The pixel pet, on the desktop or docked in the app.
messages.settings.row.companion_pet_panel.label: Desktop pet
messages.settings.row.companion_pet_panel.help: The pet can sit on the desktop as its own small window, above ordinary windows but never above a dialog you have to answer. These are presentation controls only: hiding or moving the pet never stops a task, a chat or the runtime.
messages.settings.group.advanced.title: Advanced
messages.settings.group.advanced.blurb: The runtime's own surfaces, served by this same daemon.
messages.settings.row.advanced_surfaces.label: Runtime surfaces
messages.settings.row.advanced_surfaces.help: Two pages this runtime serves alongside chat and Settings. The trace rail (/trace) shows the running turn's events, receipts and obligations as the runtime records them. The Web0 browser (/web0) is the entry page for .null sites, which an ordinary browser cannot open. Both open in their own tab or window and leave Settings where it is.
messages.settings.group.about.title: About & Diagnostics
messages.settings.group.about.blurb: The exact build answering you, and how to report a problem.
messages.settings.row.build.label: This build
messages.settings.row.build.help: The precise build answering you right now. Quote this when reporting a problem — a short commit alone does not identify a build.
messages.settings.row.toolbelt.label: Toolbelt
messages.settings.row.toolbelt.help: The capability inventory: local models, the cloud connection, web-search connections and plugins, each with its real probed state. A capability never probed reads UNKNOWN, which is neither failed nor available. Opening it reads local state only.
messages.fault.cancelled.action: No action needed; start again if you want it done.
messages.fault.confinement_refusal.action: If this change is wanted, request it explicitly so it is inside the authorized scope.
messages.fault.credential_failure.action: The vault entry failed to decrypt; re-store the credential or check the vault key.
messages.fault.evidence_corruption.action: Investigate this turn's execution ledger against the runtime event stream.
messages.fault.evm_pocket_custody_unavailable.act: Register the account watch-only or connect an external EVM signer (EIP-1193); in-process EVM custody does not exist in this build.
messages.fault.integrity_verification_failure.act: Treat the affected receipt chain as compromised; investigate before trusting its entries.
messages.fault.permission_denied.action: Check the permission policy or approval settings that govern this action.
messages.fault.provider_exhausted.action: Check quota, rate limits and billing for the configured provider.
messages.fault.provider_unavailable.action: Check the provider's status, network reachability, and configured endpoints.
messages.fault.timeout.action: If timeouts repeat, check network latency and provider responsiveness.
messages.fault.tool_unavailable.action: Enable the tool for this mode in settings, or choose a different approach.
messages.fault.unknown.action: See the fault's redacted cause chain in diagnostics; an unknown cause is never retried blind.
messages.fault.unsupported_claim.action: No action needed -- this is the grounding gate working. Check retrieval quality if frequent.
messages.fault.wallet_amount_invalid.action: Send a plain decimal amount no more precise than the coin allows and within the pilot's per-transfer ceiling.
messages.fault.wallet_approval_rejected.action: Approve the exact proposal with the owner's PIN or biometric; approvals do not transfer between proposals.
messages.fault.wallet_backup_unavailable.action: A Crypto Pilot backup is released exactly once during setup; there is no second reveal and no export for pilot wallets.
messages.fault.wallet_broadcast_failed.action: Check the test-network RPC and the proposal's receipt; the spend was not recorded as sent.
messages.fault.wallet_caller_refused.action: Drive trusted wallet doors from the served page or the native window; a page on another origin, a framed page, a text/plain form and the command-dispatch projection are refused by design.
messages.fault.wallet_card_data_refused.action: Tokenize the card with the provider and register the token reference instead.
messages.fault.wallet_chain_identity_mismatch.act: Check the RPC endpoint for the network; a lying chain id or genesis is refused before any payment.
messages.fault.wallet_confirmation_required.actio: Read the warning and type the exact confirmation phrase to proceed.
messages.fault.wallet_credential_mismatch.action: A Crypto Pilot credential is confirmed before any key material exists.
messages.fault.wallet_dependency_unavailable.acti: Install the EVM extras (eth-abi, eth-utils, eth-account) to enable the EVM lanes; every other wallet lane works without them.
messages.fault.wallet_disabled.action: Enable the wallet explicitly (VOOL_WALLET_ENABLED=1) only if payments are wanted on this install.
messages.fault.wallet_duplicate_payment.action: Check the existing proposal's receipt; use a new idempotency key for a genuinely new payment.
messages.fault.wallet_environment_inactive.action: Choose the network environment deliberately in Crypto settings; accounts, balances and receipts never move between environments.
messages.fault.wallet_export_refused.action: Recover a VOOL Wallet from the phrase written down at creation; there is no export door to enable.
messages.fault.wallet_insufficient_funds.action: Spendable excludes other in-flight holds; a Solana remainder must be zero-free and at least the rent minimum in the pilot.
messages.fault.wallet_legacy_surface_retired.acti: Use the wallet tools (wallet.propose) or the wallet API; the legacy signer, spender and exporter no longer exist.
messages.fault.wallet_limit_exceeded.action: Review the per-transaction, daily and per-destination limits before retrying.
messages.fault.wallet_network_disabled.action: Use one of the declared network rows; undeclared chains, aliases and look-alike names are refused by construction.
messages.fault.wallet_not_found.action: Check the wallet id, proposal id or destination address and try again.
messages.fault.wallet_outbound_refused.action: Check the declared RPC origins and payment-resource policy; private, metadata and unapproved hosts are refused.
messages.fault.wallet_pin_invalid.action: Use a 6 to 12 digit PIN; a wrong PIN leaves the sealed key untouched.
messages.fault.wallet_quote_expired.action: A quote lives for a short window and is superseded by a refresh or an environment switch; approval never carries over.
messages.fault.wallet_quote_mismatch.action: An approval binds one quote digest; a changed account, chain, recipient, amount, environment or fee ceiling invalidates it.
messages.fault.wallet_quote_unavailable.action: Unknown chain data is never treated as zero; check the row's endpoint and its identity proof.
messages.fault.wallet_recipient_refused.action: Refused: a new Solana account below the rent minimum, an executable or off-curve account, a bad EIP-55 checksum, the zero address, precompiles and system contracts.
messages.fault.wallet_recovery_refused.action: Recovery re-seals an existing wallet only from a backup that decodes to the wallet's own key (both derivations agree), or from an enrolled device secret released by fresh user presence; a wrong or foreign key is refused before any write and counted on the recovery throttle only.
messages.fault.wallet_request_ambiguous.action: A transfer names one account on one network; the candidates are listed in the fault context.
messages.fault.wallet_setup_state_invalid.action: Setup moves generating, awaiting backup, backup revealed, ready; cancel and resume never reveal a backup twice.
messages.fault.wallet_signature_invalid.action: Check the connected signer; a mismatched signature is refused before broadcast.
messages.fault.wallet_signing_unavailable.action: Connect the external wallet, or create a VOOL Wallet after reading its warning.
messages.fault.wallet_simulation_failed.action: Check the balance, the destination and the test-network RPC, then propose again.
messages.fault.wallet_storage_class_refused.actio: Crypto Pilot wallets are refused while VOOL_KEY_STORAGE_MODE is ephemeral; use file or keyring storage.
messages.fault.wallet_unlock_throttled.action: Failed unlocks are counted durably per wallet and for the whole app, across restarts; the lock lifts on its own after the stated wait.
messages.fault.wallet_x402_cap_exceeded.action: Raise VOOL_WALLET_X402_CAP_MINOR deliberately, or pay the resource by an explicit proposal.
messages.fault.x402_scheme_unavailable.action: Use an offer whose scheme, token and facilitator are verified for the network; partial signing support is never improvised.

messages.vx.memory.title: Memory
messages.vx.memory.empty: Nothing remembered yet — confirmed facts land here with their stored scope, and each can be forgotten.
messages.vx.privacy.title: Privacy & data
messages.vx.privacy.p1: Chats, memory, receipts and generated files live in this machine’s VOOL home; nothing leaves it on the local lane.
messages.vx.privacy.p2: A cloud call happens only for a cloud-pinned or Auto-free turn with your key; Local Only blocks the cloud lane entirely, including free models.
messages.vx.privacy.p3: Provider keys live in the system keychain/encrypted store and are never rendered back into this page.
messages.vx.privacy.p4: Paid pins require server-confirmed consent; accepted ceilings re-gate on price rises.
messages.vx.privacy.p5: Retention windows and cloud-learning controls are not shown because no enforcement for them exists yet — an unenforced toggle would be a lie.
messages.vx.toolbelt.title: Toolbelt
messages.vx.toolbelt.law: UNKNOWN ≠ FAILED: a capability never probed reads UNKNOWN — we do not know yet, and that is the honest state.
messages.activity.field.usepod.dna_fees_owed: DNA fees owed after this call
messages.activity.review_prices_note: (opens the max input/output prices this model dispatches under; opening reviews nothing, sends nothing)
messages.settings.pane.empty: This section has nothing to show.
messages.settings.pane.calendar_missing: The calendar accounts panel did not load.
messages.settings.pane.notifications_missing: The notifications panel did not load.
messages.settings.pane.wallet_missing: The wallet surface did not load.
messages.settings.row.accept_hive_tasks.label: Take shared research tasks
messages.settings.row.accept_hive_tasks.help: Let VOOL claim work from the shared task pool while it is idle. Off means VOOL stays visible to other agents but claims nothing.
messages.settings.row.idle_research_assist.label: Research while idle
messages.settings.row.idle_research_assist.help: Let VOOL keep researching an open question when you are not typing.
messages.settings.row.hive_followups.label: Tell me what came back
messages.settings.row.hive_followups.help: Show follow-up messages when shared research finishes, instead of staying quiet.
messages.settings.row.hive_followups.effect: Applies from your next message. The turn in flight keeps the old value.
messages.settings.row.social_commons.label: Talk to other agents
messages.settings.row.social_commons.help: Let VOOL join the agent commons to brainstorm with other agents.
